authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 sections 20.4.72 GROUP and 20.4.74 DICTIONARYVAR specify member and common handle references; libdxfrw's public representations store these identities as uint32_t.
source: Adapted the bounded fixes and controls from locally available diverged tracked-branch commits 64ff368cecda92cad93184a427426b9509d19f21 and a52a1b054287ea6a43405c5f0d3733cdd1f436cd; no merge or overwrite of that branch was performed.
finding: A five-byte reference 0x100000001 could alias 0x1 after truncation in a GROUP member or DICTIONARYVAR owner, reactor or extension-dictionary link.
change: Require representable common references for DICTIONARYVAR's legacy dictionary-role path and reject unrepresentable GROUP member references before publication.
validation: The new controls failed against the preceding implementation, then passed after the fix: the DWG object-vector executable and libdxfrw_dwg_ac1014_dictionaryvar CTest.
R13/R14 GROUP wide-member controls and R13 DICTIONARYVAR wide-owner/reactor/extension controls check cleared state and successful same-object retry.
Both owning targets were rebuilt and passed in the local Debug AddressSanitizer build with the library instrumented.
limits: The test vectors establish bounded parser safety, not native dictionary merge or whole-file output semantics.
Selected inputs changed, so prior platform and hosted qualification digests do not qualify this candidate.
